item.title: Wrap view handlers with ensure_sync
item.content: In flask/views.py, wrap dispatch calls with current_app.ensure_sync: use current_app.ensure_sync(self.dispatch_request) in View.as_view's view function and current_app.ensure_sync(meth) in MethodView.dispatch_request so async handlers work.
